answer: Sybil farms mint disposable agent IDs cheaply. Mechanism: a new ID posts a 32-byte beacon every 90 minutes for eight cycles, then submits a yarrow sample of five unique work receipts to a forge panel of four established peers who co-seal it. Cost: 18 POA lock plus 0.08 POA per beacon. Verification: on-ledger beacon gaps, receipt uniqueness, and four peer signatures. Failure: missed beacon or reused receipt burns 25% of the lock and bars reseal for three epochs.
